added_lines: the church of our lady of lourdes serving the parishes of steelstown & culmore sunday 11th october 2026 28th sunday in ordinary time during his recent visit to the grotto of massabielle in lourdes, pope leo xiv made the fol lowing appeal. dear brothers and sisters: i would like to make an appeal that is particularly close to my heart, here in this place. it was here that the immaculate virgin appeared to saint bernadette with the rosary and, as it were, guided her in prayer. for this reason, today i invite all the faithful and all christian com munities to pray the holy rosary throughout the coming month of october, with the particular intention that wars may cease and that peace may be established among peoples in conflict. let us accompany this prayer with concrete acts of penance and mercy, committing ourselves always to fostering dialogue and reconcili ation. may our most holy mother intercede for us!” as we gather here in this church, dedicated to our lady of lourdes, let us take up the pope’s i nvitation and commit to praying the holy rosary each day for peace in our hearts and in our homes, in our country and in our world! the rosary is recited here on mondays at 6.30pm and on tuesdays-saturdays at 9.30am. queen of the most holy rosary, pray for us! confessions weekend saturday: after 10am mass; 5.45pm – 6.25pm sunday: 10.30am – 10.50am weekdays monday : 6.30pm – 6.55pm tuesday : 8.10am – 8.30am thursday : 9.30am – 09.50am mass times sundays vigil: 6.30pm sunday: 09.00am; 11.00am; 12.15pm weekdays monday – friday: 7.45am monday: 7.00pm tuesday – saturday: 10.00am devotions eucharistic adoration thursday: 08.00 – 09.55am 10.30am – 12 noon rosary before 10am mass divine mercy chaplet after 10am mass steelstown

mission sunday 18 october– next sunday is mission sunday, a day when we are given the opportun ity to express unity and solidarity with christian communities all over the world. contributions will be used to build simple mission churches, to educate seminarians as well as female reli gious novices, to assist in the formation of catechists and lay leaders, for building health facilities for children and adults as well as for providing emergency aid in times of war or natural disaster or to assist missionaries in their efforts to care for refugees. there is an envelope in your box for the mission sunday collection. parish cells – next weekend, after all masses, you are invited to the conference room to learn about the ‘parish cell system of evangelisation’. parish cells are small groups of 4 to 12 people who meet in their home every two weeks to deepen their faith and friendship, to encourage one another in living their christian faith each day, and to explore simple ways of sharing the gospel with others. for more information, visit: parishcellsireland.ie. bible alive renewal reminder– the parish order of bible alive is due for renewal in november. bible alive is a monthly booklet which provides commentary and reflection the readings used at mass each day plus articles relating to scripture, prayer and life. if you wish to order bib le alive for the next year, please contact the sacristan. cost is £30 per year or £3 per month. if paying by cheque, please make payable to:‘our lady of lourdes church’. donations-fr mcgeehan acknowledges a donation of £40 for those in need and also donations for the holy family parish in gaza. the columban young adults – are a new group for those aged 18 - 30 in the diocese, who are seeking a community of like-minded young adults who have christ at the centre of their l ives. our october event will be a holy hour and meditation next thursday 15th october, 7:00pm at our lady of lourdes church, steelstown, delivered by fr declan mcgeehan. the meditation will be followed by solemn benedic tion and light refreshments. we are actively seeking new members- please come along and bring a friend! the eucharistic miracles of the world-come and discover the remarkable stories of eucharistic miracles from around the world, brought together through the inspiring work of st carlo acutis. this exhibition offers an opportunity for prayer, reflection and a deepening faith. running until 16 october in st eugene’s cathedral hall, infirmary road, derry. admission is free, all welcome. rise & shine trust –group 110 (derry) do you know a young person who would benefit from a week of friendship, fun, faith and unforgettable memories in lourdes? rise & shine trust brings children (11+) and young adults with additional needs on a week-long pilgrimage holiday to lourdes each easter. the trip is free for our guests as our volunteers fundraise for it. for more information, and to apply, please see w ww.riseandshine.ie. parishes of glendermott & strathfoyle sunday 18th october 2026 twenty-ninth sunday in ordinary time world mission sunday - 18th october 2026 this weekend the church celebrates world mission sunday, the weekend when the pope annually invites all catholics throughout the world to support the churches missionary life. world mission sunday is the day set aside by the catholic church throughout the world to publicly renew its commitment to its universal mission, it’s calling to bring the good news of christ to the ends of the earth. in his message marking the 100th world mission sunday pope leo reminded us that the unity of the church as a community of christ’s disciples is inseparable from its missionary outreach to the world: ‘the unity of disciples is not an end in itself; it is directed towards mission. it is through the witness of a reconciled, fraternal and united community that the proclamation of the gospel acquires its full communicative power.’ as christ’s disciples, we are all called and sent to be instruments of his compassion in the context of our broken, confused and anxiety riven world. while all baptised members of the church are called to bear witness to christ and the gospel of love, wherever they are, there is also, within the church, a special calling to mission outside one’s own cultural or national setting – mission ad gentes. down through the centuries the church’s mission to the nations was carried out by the members of missionary congregations and societies, ready and willing to embark upon a courageous outreach to peoples and cultures outside their homelands. irish missionaries and their supporters have made, and continue to make, an outstanding contribution to this missionary outreach. without the inspiration and leadership given by these women and men, the missionary impulse of the church would have gradually diminished and died out, and the church would have never realised its essential vocation to bring the good news to the ends of the earth. waterside strathfoyle amalgamated)

new diocesan appointments – towards the end of last week bishop michael router announced new diocesan appointments. fr patrick lagan who has served as curate here for the past 4 years is to become the new parish priest of both greencastle and gortin in co tyrone. he is replaced here by fr stephen baxter who was ordained here in waterside on 14th june this year. fr lagan takes up his new appointment on 30th october. baptisms – we welcome into god’s family: kiara kathleen gillespie, the old fort anniversaries – for those whose anniversaries occur around this time tina keyes (nee herron), peter o’donnell, sarah mcgee, susan mccauley, noel patrick mcginley, lily and barry mccallion, jim irvine, helen magee, grainne sheils, patrick o’donnell, noreen o’kane, evelyn friel, eddie mclaughlin, maureen phillips, jackie mclaughlin, jean feeny. offertory collections: glendermott: £4175 strathfoyle: £525 second collection this weekend is the annual mission collection thank you for your generosity to the parish collections. unlocking the mystery of the bible many of us want to read the bible but can find it difficult to understand. the parish will be running ‘unlocking the mystery of the bible’, an eight-part course that will help us to understand the main story of the bible and how all the different parts fit together. it gives the ‘big picture’ and helps us see what the bible is really about. we will meet on monday evenings starting on 2nd november at 8pm (after 7.30pm mass) in the parish hall, st columb’s church. sessions will begin with prayer, followed by a video presentation and small group discussion. by the end, you’ll feel more confident reading the bible and have a better understanding of how you fit into god’s plan. to register for the course, please leave your name and contact details at the parish office (028 71 342303 or email

prayer for the missionaries lord our god, loving father, we humbly pray to you for our beloved missionaries, heralds of the gospel, may our prayers reach their hearts that they may feel our love, our strength, our faith. may our prayers reach their hearts that they continue with your zeal the mission you entrust them with. may their presence in their community be a reminder of your presence among us. amen.
